title: Warm Turkish Foie Gras Icli Kofte
description: A tangy and light Turkish dish featuring foie gras, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this Jain-friendly recipe is pressure cooked in a Dutch oven and served in the form of icli kofte.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and cook until they are softened.
Add the sliced foie gras and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Add the bulgur, tomato paste, pomegranate molasses, salt, and black pepper to the Dutch oven.
Stir well to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water to the Dutch oven and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use a pressure cooker to cook the mixture for 5 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally and serve the icli kofte warm.
